set.body:
Implement fixed-parameter Gaussian-velocity two-state Viterbi decoding with typed validated parameters, log-space arithmetic and explicit missingness/event-boundary policies. Pin the pymovements 0.28.0 parameters and conventions without copying implementation as the only oracle. Acceptance: exhaustive tiny-state-path enumeration, degenerate variance/probability rejection, tie and underflow cases, public API tests and named comparator differences. Parameter re-estimation/Baum-Welch is a separate next slice; create it before claiming full I-HMM coverage.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.7 Implement fixed-parameter two-state I-HMM decoding
